Skanderborg is a Danish municipality evaluated in the Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP). The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, focusing on anticoagulation therapy coverage and safety monitoring. 

Skanderborg is particularly notable for its high performance regarding Indicator 4b, which measures adherence to safety practices when using DOAC (Direct Oral Anticoagulant) medications. The municipality successfully met the standard for this indicator, achieving a compliance rate of 96.0% (924 out of 962 eligible cases) [^src1]. This result is marked as "Yes" for meeting the standard and ranks among the highest values recorded in the entire report [^src1]. 

In other sections of the report detailing different clinical indicators—such as the early initiation of anticoagulation treatment (Indicator 1) or the prevention of ischemic stroke (Indicator 5)—Skanderborg's data reflects different patient cohorts and metrics. For instance, in a separate indicator breakdown, the municipality recorded a metric of 0.4% (5 out of 1,306), alongside a related sub-metric of 5 out of 1,273 (0.4%) against an expected value of 0.6 [^src2]. Despite the lower percentage in this specific metric, the municipality's comprehensive data reporting underscores its active role in the decentralized quality development and benchmarking of the Danish healthcare system.
